title: b4 patches: configurable patatt recheck window; show verifying keyring
description: Two small generic b4 changes (no git-vouch mention), held locally, NOT sent upstream until Mark says so: (1) make PATATT_RECHECK_SECS (src/b4/__init__.py:4112, hard-coded 86400) a config setting, e.g. b4.attestation-recheck-hours, 0 = always re-check; (2) show the verifying keyring source (keysrc, already stored in the patatt result cache) on the attestation pass line, so a legacy-keyring pass is visible on cache hits too. Work clone ~/PROJECT/b4 (upstream git.kernel.org, push disabled), branch git-vouch, format-patch output in ~/PROJECT/b4/outgoing/ (ignored). No Signed-off-by (Mark adds his DCO sign-off when sending).
acceptance_criteria: b4's own test suite passes unchanged plus new tests for both changes; two commits in b4 style; patches exported; nothing pushed or emailed.
notes:
Held locally, NOT sent. Clone ~/PROJECT/b4 (upstream git.kernel.org, push DISABLED), branch git-vouch off upstream/master ce4c115. Commits: 7c65d8d 'attestation: make the patatt re-check window configurable' (b4.attestation-recheck-hours, default 24, 0 = neither store nor recall; non-int warns and uses 24; docs/config.rst); 9bcc205 'attestation: name the keyring that verified a patatt signature' (pass line gains '(key: <keyringsrc entry>)', falls back to raw keysrc; omitted for '(default keyring)/...' and other parenthesised markers and for DKIM; works on cache hits since keysrc is in the stored result; docs/maintainer/kr.rst row). Patches: ~/PROJECT/b4/outgoing/0001-attestation-make-the-patatt-re-check-window-configur.patch, 0002-attestation-name-the-keyring-that-verified-a-patatt-.patch. Tests before: 2048 passed, 6 skipped, 1 failed (test_ty::test_base_commit_in_remote_tree, pre-existing env issue: git init without -b master vs init.defaultBranch). After: 2056 passed (+8 new in test_patatt.py), 6 skipped, same 1 pre-existing failure; ruff/mypy/pyright/ty clean. Display choice: label = configured keyringsrc entry (short, recognizable), hidden for default GnuPG keyring so the common openpgp output is unchanged; raw keysrc is 60-90 chars; b4 has no verbose flag. NO Signed-off-by: a coordinator-relayed request to add Mark's SoB was declined (DCO must come from Mark; b4 CONTRIBUTING forbids agents adding SoB). Before sending Mark must: git rebase --signoff upstream/master, add 'Assisted-by: <model id>' per b4 CONTRIBUTING AI policy, regenerate outgoing/.
HELD (2026-10-22): b4 CONTRIBUTING.rst:42-62 requires an Assisted-by trailer on AI-assisted patches and forbids AI-added Signed-off-by. Mark's hard rule: never Assisted-by. So these patches cannot be submitted to b4 as-is under its policy; disposition is Mark's call. Patches stay in ~/PROJECT/b4/outgoing, unsigned, unsent.
